target: Reproduce section 3.1 wall-impact pressure histories (Fig. 5) using the existing dam-break builder.

target: Reproduce the section 3.3 3D rectangular-step experiment (Fig. 17).

target: Named three-dimensional obstacle case with experimental water-height/pressure data.
metrics: Gauges, pressure and free-surface evolution.

target: Separate lateral-water, lateral-oil and roof-impact protocols and their motion records.
metrics: Sensor traces, impulse and repeatability for each experiment.

metrics: Semi-axes and energy over finite time.
prerequisite: Explicit force-free setup and analytic ODE adapter.

target: Named wet-bed experiment with matched gate and downstream depth.
metrics: Surface profiles and front evolution.

target: Double-rarefaction low-density Riemann problem.

prerequisite: Audit whether existing Sod state knobs express the exact setup before adding a factory.

target: Shock interacting with sinusoidal entropy/density structure.
metrics: Resolved post-shock oscillations and density profiles against converged reference.
prerequisite: New IC profile and independently verified high-order reference.

target: Oblique incident shock with standard moving boundary data.
metrics: Shock/contact locations and density contours/profiles.
prerequisite: Distinguish from registered one-dimensional shockReflection; match corner/boundary protocol.
